test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

How have they been ordered by the minister?

options.text: How have the minister ordered them?
How had the minister ordered them?
How did the minister order them?
How has the minister ordered them?

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "How have they been ordered by the minister?"
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the minister" at the beginning.</
